app.tagline: Pokémon battles on the big screen. Your phone is the controller.

common.wakingUp: Warming up the stadium… this can take up to a minute.

home.lead: Turn any TV into a Pokémon stadium. Friends scan a QR, build their teams on their phones and battle together on the big screen. No accounts, nothing to install.

lobby.title: Battle lobby
lobby.hint: New trainers join the team with fewer players. They can switch from their phone.

join.title: Join from your phone
join.stepScan: Scan the QR with your camera
join.stepProfile: Pick a name and a trainer
join.stepTeam: Choose the red or blue team

composition.waitingHint: Scan the QR code to join.

hint.TEAM_EMPTY: Scan the QR code to join, or move a trainer to that team.
hint.TEAM_TOO_LARGE: Switch to Doubles or move a trainer to the other team.
